notes.title: EliosVR conversion to free(time correction)
notes.content:
Hello, this is EliosVR.

We decided to switch to a free service so that more users can play together in the future.
The free transition date is [strike]15:00[/strike]  10:00 on May 21, 2021 Korean time.

We plan to collect feedback from users who have purchased EliosVR and modify it so that they can enjoy a wider variety of content.
In addition, we would like to hold an event for users who purchased for a fee.

[In-Game Purchase Reward Event]
For: Anyone who made a purchase prior to the May 21st Free Conversion

Free commemorative event
1. Free Conversion Event 1: May 14th-May 20th (7th)
Reward item: High B equipment box (weapon, armor, gloves, shoes)

2. Free Conversion Event 2: May 14th ~ May 20th (7th)
Reward Item: Enchant Stone

* Reward items can be received through "Menu => Events" after logging in.
* For Free Conversion Event 1, you can receive items by logging in only 4 out of 7 days.
* For Free Conversion Event 2, log in for 7 days to receive more Enchant Stone.

Hello, this is EliosVR.

The official forum releases are as follows:



[h3]Changed[/h3]
1. Fixed the phenomenon that the phrase "Level Up" is only visible in one direction

2. Teleport travel distance adjustment (reduction)

3. Monster bug fixes
-Fixed some monsters not being attacked or damaged by monsters

4. Edit store page content
-Change the play space size



[h3]Bug related inquiries[/h3]
1. Infinite loading (infinite loading after selecting a character)
    -As a solution to this problem, if you have modified it to log in again but still can't access it, we need your information to fix it. Please send screenshots, PC specs and VR device information to info@fingereyes.com for improvement.
